I’m in. What kind of party are we throwing—house party, dinner party, themed, or something outdoors?

Tell me:
1) How many people  
2) Budget (low/medium/high)  
3) Vibe (chill, classy, chaotic, dancey)  
4) Date/time + location constraints  
5) Any must-haves (music style, games, food, drinks)

And I’ll help you plan a tight setup: playlist, menu, drinks, timeline, and a few easy “wow” touches.
